situation_facts: The touring marionette bridge for the production The Tin Heron fails the Kelvinhaugh Playhouse point-load requirement of 1.5 kilonewtons; it was tested at 0.9 kilonewtons on 28 March.
Kelvinhaugh Playhouse will not permit rigging that fails their load requirement, so the venue date cannot proceed without a rebuild.
Rebuilding the bridge takes three workshop days.
The tour truck loads on 14 April and the workshop has only two free days before load-out.
Freelance carpenter Basil Ntende is available 10 to 12 April if he is booked by 5 April, which would cover the third day.
Basil's rate is three hundred and forty pounds per day, so three days is one thousand and twenty pounds.
Overtime and freelance bookings are approved by Marguerite Vaudrey-Pinto.
The Kelvinhaugh date is the opening night of the tour.
